normalized.description:
The specific subject of this contract is the continuation of the operation of the Circular Cities and Regions Initiative’s Coordination and Support Office (CCRI-CSO II). More specifically, the contractor will support the European Commission in managing, steering and further consolidating the Circular Cities and Regions Initiative.

To do so, this service contract shall build on the processes put in place and results achieved by the Coordination Support Office I (operating from December 2021 to December 2025). 

The overarching goal of the contract shall be to further expand and consolidate the CCRI initiative with a view of creating an ever more knowledgeable, competent, larger and geographically diverse community of circular cities/regions/hubs, committed to advancing their circular transition.
